max_tire.note: Eurowise rates its W463A kit for 33-inch tires without rubbing, depending on wheel offset, and says it has tested 33.5 in. Bigger tires can set off driver-assist warnings (active brake assist, blind-spot, cruise)

items.title: Front-axle wiring harness chafe
items.summary: Front-axle harness can chafe on the oil cooler, disabling ABS and ESC; dealers sleeve or replace it. 26,116 G 550s and G 63s

items.title: Differential-lock module resistor
items.summary: A resistor in the diff-lock module can fail and interrupt communication with the actuator, possibly switching off ESP and ABS; 6,300 trucks

items.title: Rear door latch
items.summary: Door-latch components may stop the rear doors latching or opening properly; 17,800 trucks

items.title: Replacement rear door latch
items.summary: Trucks that got a replacement latch in service or an earlier recall may have a faulty right-rear latch

items.title: Front door wiring harness routing
items.summary: Misrouted front-door harnesses can be damaged by opening and closing the doors

items.title: Fuel tank weld
items.summary: Fuel tank may not have been welded properly, risking a leak (3 trucks)

items.title: Turbo oil feed line (AMG G 63)
items.summary: Oil feed line to the turbocharger may leak on 4.0 V8 AMG models

items.title: Fuel pump shutdown
items.summary: Fuel pump may shut down, causing loss of drive power

items.title: ESP warning light (G 550, G 580, G 63)
items.summary: ESP may show the wrong warning light during a system failure (FMVSS 126/101)

items.title: Wheel bolts (G 580)
items.summary: Incorrect wheel bolts may have been fitted at the factory; 3,734 G 580s

timeline.change: New G unveiled at Detroit in January (G 550) and Geneva in March (AMG G 63). Independent front suspension, rack-and-pinion steering, 9G-TRONIC; about 170 kg lighter
US launch; Mercedes-Benz USA's 2019 G 550 spec sheet lists $124,500 plus $995 destination. EPA 14 mpg combined for the V8 G 550
Early trucks carry several recalls, including the front-axle harness (23V097), diff-lock module (20V090) and rear door latch (21V353). Confirm by VIN that they were done
AMG G 63 4×4² launched in June (MY2023 in the US, $350,050)
Final Edition G 500 V8 announced: 1,500 built, 500 in each of three colours
Updated G (media designation W465) revealed in March; the G 580 with EQ Technology follows in April
US G 550 switches to a 3.0-litre mild-hybrid inline-six (443 hp, EPA 18 mpg combined); G 580 EV arrives with four motors and 33.5 in wading depth

identify.intro: Many G 550s are dressed up as G 63s, and the 2019-on trucks look a lot like the old ones. The VIN shows what you're looking at.

items.head: VIN characters 4–8
items.body: Bring a Trailer examples decoded with NHTSA's vPIC tool: 2019 G 550 = WDCYC6BJ…, 2019 AMG G 63 = WDCYC7HJ…, 2023 G 550 = W1NYC6BJ…, 2025 G 550 (inline-six) = W1NWH1AB…, 2025 G 580 = W1NWM0AB…. A 'G 63' with a YC6 VIN is a G 550 in AMG clothing.

items.head: WDC versus W1N
items.body: The 2019 examples start WDC and the 2023–2025 examples start W1N. Both are Mercedes-Benz manufacturer prefixes, and vPIC decodes both as Graz-built G-Class.

items.head: Model year (10th character)
items.body: K = 2019, L = 2020, P = 2023, S = 2025. The V8 G 550 runs through 2024; 2025-on G 550s are inline-six mild hybrids.

items.head: 'W463A' isn't official
items.body: 'W463A' is an enthusiast and media label. Mercedes kept the W463 chassis code for the 2018-on truck, and the 2024 update has been reported as W465.

items.head: Electric G 580
items.body: The G 580 has no mechanical lockers. It uses per-wheel torque vectoring with a 2:1 low range in each axle's transmission.

capability.note: MBUSA 2019 spec sheet, breakover at maximum load; launch press quoted 31° / 30° / 26°

capability.v: EPA 13 city / 17 hwy / 14 comb (2019 V8); 17 / 19 / 18 (2025 inline-six); G 580: 62 MPGe combined, 239-mile range

values.intro: Early 2019 G 550s are now the cheapest way into the new G. AMG G 63s keep a clear premium, and the electric G 580 is losing value quickly.
values.note: Based on Bring a Trailer sales from January 2025 to October 2026: 13 G 550 and G 580 sales ($72,000–188,500) and 26 standard AMG G 63s (median $146,500). Mercedes-Benz USA's 2019 spec sheet lists the G 550 at $124,500 before destination.
